name: PCI DSS
description: Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard v4.0 (paraphrased requirement subset relevant to scanning, inventory, access and policy).

controls.title: Inventory of system components
controls.description: An inventory of system components in scope for PCI DSS is maintained and kept current.
controls.evidence_guidance: Current asset inventory covering in-scope components.

checks.rationale: A maintained asset inventory is the 2.4 artifact.

controls.title: Access assignment by role and least privilege
controls.description: Access to system components and data is assigned based on job classification and least privilege, and approved.

checks.rationale: The access-control policy defines the role/least-privilege rules.
Recorded role assignments evidence assignment by role.

controls.title: Audit logs capture activity
controls.description: Audit logs are implemented to record required events and support anomaly detection and forensics.

checks.rationale: An operative audit trail recording administrative events is the direct 10.2 artifact.

controls.title: Internal vulnerability scans (quarterly)
controls.description: Internal vulnerability scans are performed at least once every three months, high-risk and critical vulnerabilities are resolved, and rescans confirm resolution.
controls.evidence_guidance: Quarterly completed scan runs; zero unresolved criticals; verification rescans.

checks.rationale: PCI 11.3.1 mandates a scan at least every three months — a completed run in the last 92 days is direct proof.
11.3.1 requires high-risk/critical vulnerabilities to be resolved.

controls.title: Scan coverage of in-scope components
controls.description: Vulnerability scans cover all in-scope system components.
controls.evidence_guidance: Scan target coverage across the asset inventory.

checks.rationale: Coverage % of active assets scanned proves scans reach all in-scope components.

controls.title: Penetration testing methodology and execution
controls.description: External and internal penetration testing is performed per a defined methodology at least annually and after significant changes.

checks.rationale: The annual pen-test report is the 11.4.1 artifact.

controls.title: Information security policy
controls.description: An overall information security policy is established, published, maintained, and disseminated to all relevant personnel.

checks.rationale: An active, disseminated, acknowledged policy is the direct 12.1 artifact.

controls.title: Security awareness training
controls.description: Personnel receive security awareness training upon hire and at least annually.

controls.title: Third-party service provider risk
controls.description: Risk to information assets associated with third-party service provider relationships is managed.

checks.rationale: Annual vendor security reviews evidence 12.8 management.

controls.title: Incident response plan
controls.description: An incident response plan exists and is ready to be activated in the event of a suspected or confirmed security incident.
controls.evidence_guidance: IR policy plus timely remediation of criticals.

checks.rationale: The published IR policy is the 12.10.1 plan.
SLA-compliant remediation shows response readiness in practice.
